name: Open Eagle Eye — verified public camera registry (stuchapin909)
license: MIT (code and registry); images © each publisher
role: About 31,000 still-image cameras checked by the registry's maintainers. tools/fetch-worldcams.mjs downloads cameras.json during the daily data job and adds only cameras that are verified, need no sign-in, use HTTPS on a reviewed public host and are not already shown (no camera within 60 m and no identical address).
